scope: Disposable MySQL: auction schema constraints, JPA validate, winner fulfilment via existing trade API, V6 upgrade/repeat/resume/restore, restart

checks.description: Fresh schema creates the nine iteration-2 tables plus three auction tables on real MySQL
MySQL 8.0 server is used
Fresh schema has 9 iteration-2 tables plus 3 auction tables
All money columns are DECIMAL(10,2)
Auction lookup, due-scan, bid history and reminder indexes exist
Mode-immutability trigger is installed
Backend validates the auction tables with Hibernate ddl-auto=validate
Products published by the existing API default to FIXED_PRICE and keep the intent flow
Trigger refuses switching a published product to AUCTION
Unknown selling modes are rejected
An auction product cannot hold more than one item
A live session starts without bids, price or leader
A second session for the same product is rejected
Non-positive start price is rejected
Deadline not after start is rejected
Unknown session status is rejected
Price without a recorded bid/leader is rejected
A counted bid without a current price is rejected
ENDED_SOLD without a winner intent is rejected
Each accepted bid is traceable by sequence, buyer, amount and time
A concurrent writer reusing a bid sequence is rejected
Two accepted bids with the same amount are rejected
Bids must reference an existing customer
Repeated settlement reminders for the same session/type are rejected
Seller reminders cannot carry a customer recipient
A sold reminder must carry the final price
Winner intent completes through the existing success API: stock 0, offline, SUCCESS history
Reminders are listable per winner and for sellers
Due scan returns the expired LIVE session only
Conditional settlement applies once; a repeated scan changes nothing
An unsold session cannot link a winner intent
Handoff query samples run and the snapshot masks the leader
Due scan can use idx_auction_status_ends
Iteration-2 database is backed up, then receives V5/V6
Every existing product becomes FIXED_PRICE and existing data is unchanged
Upgraded and fresh schemas agree on columns, constraints and indexes
Repeated upgrade is recognized as auction phase and changes no data
Backup restores the pre-V6 iteration-2 database exactly
V6 resumes after an interrupted run (procedure and session table done) and matches the fresh schema
Direct V6 on a pre-V5 database stops before any change
A twelve-table layout missing an auction column is refused
MySQL restart preserves sessions, bids, reminders and the fulfilment link
Backend starts with ddl-auto=validate on the V6-upgraded database

public_snapshot.sql:
SELECT p.id product_id, p.name, p.selling_mode, a.status, a.start_price, a.min_increment,
  a.current_price, a.bid_count, a.ends_at,
  CASE WHEN a.bid_count = 0 THEN a.start_price ELSE a.current_price + a.min_increment END next_min_bid,
  CONCAT(LEFT(c.username, 1), '***', RIGHT(c.username, 1)) leader_alias
FROM auction_session a JOIN product p ON p.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = a.leader_customer_id WHERE p.id = 2

lock_for_bid.sql: SELECT id, bid_count, current_price FROM auction_session WHERE product_id = 2 FOR UPDATE

due_scan.sql: SELECT id FROM auction_session WHERE status = 'LIVE' AND ends_at <= '2026-11-06 13:46:56.162740' ORDER BY ends_at, id LIMIT 50

recent_bids.sql: SELECT bid_seq, amount, bid_at FROM auction_bid WHERE auction_id = 1 ORDER BY bid_seq DESC LIMIT 10

customer_notifications.sql:
SELECT id, notification_type, product_name_snapshot, final_price, read_at
FROM auction_notification WHERE recipient_customer_id = 2 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20

winner_fulfilment.sql:
SELECT a.id auction_id, a.status, a.current_price final_price, i.id intent_id, i.status intent_status,
  h.status history_status FROM auction_session a JOIN purchase_intent i ON i.id = a.winner_intent_id
LEFT JOIN order_history h ON h.intent_id = i.id WHERE a.id = 1
